**Date:** The financing was announced on 14 March 2023.
**Named person:** Delphine Ashworth-Reyes, Head of Residential Lending at Calloway Mutual, confirmed the arrangement.
**Figure:** The loan facility totals £48.6 million to fund 212 homes.
**Source document:** The report rests on the Garrow Heights Development Financing Agreement, filed with the Harrowmere Borough Planning Registry.
